app.name: RemoteMusicRP
app.tagline: Your Last.fm listening, on your Discord profile.
app.unreachable: Can't reach RemoteMusicRP. Check that it's running, then reload.

unlock.title: Unlock RemoteMusicRP
unlock.body: This instance keeps its master key encrypted with your passphrase. Enter it to start.
unlock.first: The first passphrase you enter becomes the passphrase. Use at least 12 characters and keep it safe: without it, stored credentials can't be recovered.
unlock.label: Passphrase

login.title: Log in
login.code_hint: 6 digits from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.remember: Keep me logged in on this device for 30 days
login.forgot: Forgot your password? On the machine running RemoteMusicRP, run: remotemusicrp reset-password

elsewhere.title: Finish setup on the other computer
elsewhere.body: RemoteMusicRP doesn't have a password yet. For safety, the first password is set on the computer it runs on.
elsewhere.step_open: On the computer running RemoteMusicRP, click its tray icon, or open:
elsewhere.step_open_hint: This address only works on that computer.
elsewhere.waiting: This page moves on to the login by itself once that's done.
elsewhere.headless_body: For a server or NAS, use the one-time setup code printed in its log when RemoteMusicRP started.
elsewhere.use_code: Set up from here with a setup code

wizard.title: Set up RemoteMusicRP
wizard.intro: Three short steps. Everything you enter stays on this machine.
wizard.password_body: Set a password for this page. Without one, any program on this computer can open it.
wizard.password_required: This page is reachable from other machines, so a password is required.
wizard.setup_code_hint: Printed in the log when RemoteMusicRP started (on Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\RemoteMusicRP\desktop.log).
wizard.discord_body: RemoteMusicRP shows your music through your own Discord application. Its name is what friends see after "Listening to".
discord_steps: Open the Discord Developer Portal and sign in.
Click "New Application" and give it a name, such as "Music" or "RemoteMusicRP".
On the General Information page, copy the Application ID.
Paste it below. Keep the Discord desktop app running on this computer.
wizard.lastfm_body: RemoteMusicRP reads what you're playing from your Last.fm profile, using your own free API key.
lastfm_steps: Open the Last.fm API account page and sign in.
Fill in the form. Any application name works; leave the callback URL empty.
Copy the API key (not the shared secret).
wizard.done_body: Play a song in any app that scrobbles to Last.fm. Your Discord status updates within a few seconds.
discord_steps_sdk: Open the Discord Developer Portal and sign in.
Click "New Application" and give it a name, such as "Music" or "RemoteMusicRP".
On the General Information page, copy the Application ID and paste it below.
After setup, sign in with Discord on the Connections page (server mode needs no Discord app on this machine).

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.nothing_hint: Start a song in any app that scrobbles to Last.fm. RemoteMusicRP checks every few seconds.
dashboard.paused_hint: Your Discord status is hidden until you resume.
dashboard.discord_off: Waiting for the Discord desktop app
dashboard.needs_setup: Finish setup to start showing your music.
dashboard.hidden_quiet_hint: Your Discord status is hidden until quiet hours end.
dashboard.hidden_blocked_artist: Hidden on Discord: this artist is on your blocklist.
dashboard.hidden_blocked_track: Hidden on Discord: this song is on your blocklist.

preview.empty: Discord shows nothing while no music is playing.

presence.title: Presence
presence.intro: Choose what your Discord profile shows while you listen.
presence.name_source_hint: Shown on your profile and, if chosen below, in the member list.
presence.name_source_overridden: Not used right now: the member-list choice below puts the artist (or album) here instead.
presence.status_line_hint: The line people see under your name.
presence.one_line: Song title and artist on one line
presence.templates_hint: Use {track}, {artist} and {album}. Hidden fields are left out.
presence.links_hint: Make the text clickable on your profile. Links go to Last.fm.
presence.link_title: Song title opens the song page
presence.buttons_hint: Discord shows up to two buttons, and only other people see them.
presence.get_status_hint: Links to the RemoteMusicRP project so friends can set it up too.
presence.too_many_buttons: Three buttons are on. Discord shows only the first two, in the order above.
presence.status_prefixed: Shown as “Listening to” followed by the artist (or album), without “by” or “on”. Your profile keeps “by” on its line, and its header names the artist instead of your app.
presence.hide_words_hint: Parts of the song or album name that contain these words are hidden, such as "- Remastered" or "(Live Recordings 2003-2009)". Whole words only; the song’s own name is never cut.
presence.hide_words_label: Words to hide, separated by commas

connections.title: Connections
connections.discord_mode: Local connection to the Discord desktop app on this computer.
connections.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect? Presence stops until you connect again.
connections.discord_mode_sdk: Server mode (experimental): presence is sent through the Discord Social SDK, without a Discord app on this machine.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Appearance, updates, email alerts and backups for this instance.
settings.lan_note: Open this from any device on your network. The connection isn't encrypted, so only use it on a network you trust.
settings.instance_hint: These come from the configuration file and environment. Edit them there and restart.

updates.title: Updates
updates.security: Version {v} is available and includes security fixes. Update soon.
updates.check_failed: Couldn't check for updates right now.
updates.auto_hint: Verified, signed updates install without asking. Off by default.
updates.managed: This copy is managed by your package manager or Docker. Update it there.
updates.no_key: This build can't verify updates yet. Download new versions from GitHub.
updates.disabled: Update checks are turned off in the configuration.

security.title: Security
security.password_none: No password is set. Any program on this computer can open this page.
security.changed: Password changed. Other devices were logged out.
security.totp_on: On. You'll need a code from your authenticator app when you log in.
security.totp_off: Off. Add a second step to logging in with an authenticator app.
security.totp_scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
security.recovery_body: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
security.keys_body: Stored credentials are encrypted. The master key is kept in: {where}.
security.danger_body: Erases all settings, credentials and history, and the master key. This can't be undone.

about.title: About
about.license: Free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.
about.privacy_body: No telemetry. RemoteMusicRP only talks to Last.fm, Discord, the album-art services, and (if enabled) GitHub to check for updates.

rules.title: Hide & schedule
rules.intro: Choose when your Discord status stays empty: for certain artists or songs, and during quiet hours.
rules.blocklist_hint: While a listed artist or song plays, nothing is shown on Discord. RemoteMusicRP keeps checking, so the next song appears as usual. Matching ignores upper and lower case.
rules.artists_hint: One per line. "feat." guests are ignored, so "Radiohead" also hides "Radiohead feat. …".
rules.tracks_hint: One per line: "Song title" hides it by any artist, "Artist - Song title" only by that artist. Live and remastered versions are included.
rules.quiet_hint: Hide your status at set times, for example at night or during work. Last.fm is checked less often meanwhile.
rules.all_day: Same start and end: the whole day.
rules.overnight: Runs past midnight, into the next morning.
rules.zone_hint: Leave empty to use this computer’s time zone ({zone}).

email.title: Email alerts
email.intro: Get an email when a connection needs your attention, for example when Last.fm stops accepting your API key. Emails go through your own Resend account or SMTP server; at most one per problem per day.
email.from_hint: An address your SMTP server may send from.
email.from_hint_resend: Must use a domain you verified in Resend.
email.tls_note: The connection is always encrypted: STARTTLS (usually port 587) or TLS (usually port 465). Unencrypted SMTP is not supported.
email.api_key_hint: A key with "Sending access" is enough. Create one at
email.secret_saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
email.alert_lastfm_hint: When Last.fm rejects your API key or username and your status stops updating.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Save your settings to a file, or restore them on this or another RemoteMusicRP. Your login (password and 2FA) is never included; importing keeps this instance’s login.
backup.kind_full_hint: Settings plus your Last.fm API key and email password or key, encrypted with a passphrase you choose.
backup.kind_settings_hint: Presence, Hide & schedule, connections and email settings, without any key or password. Not encrypted.
backup.passphrase_hint: At least 10 characters. You need it to restore the file; it can’t be recovered if you forget it.
backup.password_hint: Required because the file contains your keys.
backup.import_hint: Replaces the settings stored in the file. Anything the file doesn’t contain stays as it is.
backup.too_big: That file is too large to be a RemoteMusicRP export.
backup.not_json: That file is not a RemoteMusicRP export.

risks: Uses Discord’s official Social SDK, but running it on a server without a Discord app is not described in Discord’s documentation. Discord could stop it working at any time.
Linux x86_64 only. You download the SDK from your own Discord app’s developer page; RemoteMusicRP never ships it.
Your Discord sign-in is kept encrypted on this server so it keeps working after restarts. You can sign out at any time.
steps: In the Developer Portal, open your application → Social SDK, and enable it (Getting Started form).
On the OAuth2 page, turn on "Public Client".
Still on the OAuth2 page, add the redirect address below under Redirects and save.
Click "Sign in with Discord" and approve. You come back here automatically.
sdk.sign_out_confirm: Sign out of Discord? Your status stops updating until you sign in again.
sdk.online_hint: Changes your status on Discord itself, so it likely applies on your other devices too.
sdk.online_unknown: Discord hasn’t reported your status yet.
sdk.need_app_id: Enter your Discord Application ID first (Change).
sdk.state_ready: Signed in and connected to Discord
sdk.paste_hint: If the browser couldn’t open the page Discord sent you to (for example, you approved on another device), copy that page’s full address from the address bar and paste it here. It works only in this browser, within 10 minutes.
sdk.paste_invalid: That doesn’t look like the address Discord sent you to (it should contain code= and state=).
